title: Sources: Anthropic agreed to a $10B deal for computing capacity in Norway from Nvidia-backed AI cloud startup Volta; Volta says the deal runs for six years (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic agreed to a $10B deal for computing capacity in Norway from Nvidia-backed AI cloud startup Volta; Volta says the deal runs for six years — Anthropic PBC has struck a $10 billion deal for computing capacity from a months-old infrastructure startup, according to people familiar …
